lines.text: Many learners say: I get up at seven morning.
Better: I get up at seven in the morning.
In the morning! I get up at seven in the morning.

data.wrong: I get up at seven morning.
data.right: I get up at seven in the morning.

native.tip: 中文说“早上七点”，时段放在前面。英语把时间放前面，再加 in the morning。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I get up at seven morning.”😅 英语把时间放前面，再加 in the morning：“I get up at seven in the morning.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I get up at seven in the morning.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Say the time first, then in the morning.
en.caption: Do you say “I get up at seven morning.” 😅 Say the time first, then in the morning: “I get up at seven in the morning.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
